item.title: Text Neck and Neck Pain: Simple Daily Habits for Relief

item.description: Learn what causes frozen shoulder, how its three stages progress, and how gentle physiotherapy can help restore your shoulder mobility safely.

item.description: Learn how to set up your home desk and daily routine to prevent aches and pains.
